senses.def: (Norse mythology) a huge ash tree whose roots and branches hold the earth and Heaven and Hell together
An immense ash tree that is central in Norse cosmology, believed to connect the nine worlds.
ex:
1996, Carolyne Larrington (editor and translator), The Seeress's Prophecy, The Poetic Edda, page 6,
